title: Towards detecting unanticipated bias in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Proposing post-hoc, model-agnostic methods including Uncertainty Quantification (Test-Time Data Augmentation, Ensemble Methods, Verbal Uncertainty) and Explainable AI (Perturbation-based approaches, Surrogate Models, Prompting) to uncover latent, non-obvious dependencies during the inference stage.

Qualitative evaluation of generative outputs using open-ended prompting (e.g., asking the model to write a story about a tall and a short friend) to observe implicit stereotypical associations, such as assigning specific careers based on height.
